name: Fever (symptom)
description: Fever is a temporary rise in body temperature and can occur with infections, inflammation, dehydration, heat exposure, or other causes. It is a symptom rather than one specific disease.
precautions: Monitor how long the fever lasts.
Seek medical advice for severe, persistent, or concerning fever.
guidance: Get urgent medical help for confusion, breathing difficulty, seizure, severe dehydration, or a very high or persistent fever.

name: Common cold
description: The common cold is a frequent upper-respiratory illness that may cause a runny nose, congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, or mild fatigue.
precautions: Wash hands and avoid sharing personal items.
Seek advice if symptoms are severe or do not improve.
guidance: Medical advice is recommended for breathing difficulty, chest pain, dehydration, or symptoms that persist or worsen.

name: Viral infection (general reference)
description: Viral infections are caused by viruses and can affect different parts of the body. Symptoms vary widely, so a general label cannot identify the specific virus or required treatment.
precautions: Rest and maintain suitable fluid intake.
Avoid unnecessary antibiotics; they do not treat viruses.
Seek qualified medical advice when symptoms are severe or persistent.
guidance: A healthcare professional may be needed to distinguish a viral illness from bacterial infection or another cause.
